correctness.rationale: Exact Gaussian symmetry gives 2/(s sqrt(2 pi)) integral Q(t) exp(-t^2/(2s^2))dt. Taylor expansion of arctan t at infinity gives Q=A/t+O(t^-2) with A>0. The remainder after subtracting A 1_{t>=1}/t is integrable, hence dominated convergence yields B; exact E1 small-argument expansion gives logarithm and Euler constant. All parameter domains, coefficients and the mortality-window consequence have been independently reconstructed and numerical benchmark run from the delivered checker. No finite numerical experiment is used to establish the theorem.

value.rationale: Large stationary OU variance drives refuge fraction towards its two bounds but retains a thin, dynamically important Gaussian central layer. The 1/t arctangent tail creates a genuinely log-enhanced finite-noise correction rather than a naive O(1/s) law, with a positive explicit slope contrast. The rate and second constant quantify the exact source-defined predator mortality reversal window and can inform finite-noise threshold comparisons. It is a motivated all-parameter asymptotic, not an arbitrary small case or known-table recomputation.
